# AI Coding Agent Instructions

## Project Overview

This is a **Docusaurus 3.9** personal blog/portfolio site hosted on Vercel, showcasing LeetCode solutions, blog posts, education/experience history, and project portfolio. Built with React 18, featuring interactive components with animations and timeline visualizations.

**Key Tech Stack:**
- Docusaurus 3.9.2 (static site generator + docs)
- React 18 + JSX components (interactive homepage & custom components)
- Node.js 18+ required
- Framer Motion (page & element animations)
- React Vertical Timeline (experience section)
- KaTeX + Remark Math (for LaTeX equations in blog/docs)
- Vercel Analytics (integrated in homepage)

## Project Structure

```
/docs/
  /leetcode/            # 80+ LeetCode solutions (markdown, names: leetcode_N.md)
  /uvapractice/         # UVA Online Judge solutions
  _category_.json       # Defines folder labels & ordering for sidebars
/blog/                  # Blog posts (markdown/mdx, names: YYYY-MM-DD-*.md/mdx)
/src/
  /components/
    /experience/        # Experience component + styles.module.css
    /Projects/          # Projects component + Projects.module.css
  /helper/              # JSON data: experience.json, Projects.json, SideProjects.json
  /pages/index.js       # Custom React homepage (imports components & data)
  /css/custom.css       # Global CSS (Infima color vars only)
docusaurus.config.js    # Docusaurus config (build, plugins, theme settings)
sidebars.js             # Auto-generated sidebar config (uses autogenerated directive)
```

## Key Patterns & Conventions

### Content Management & Data Flow
- **Pattern**: JSON data file → React component imports & renders with `.map()`
  - Example: `/src/helper/experience.json` → imported in `index.js` → passed to `<Experience Experiences={Experiences} />`
  - Components destructure data objects: `{ experience.title, experience.points, experience.icon }` etc.
- **Component Files**: Each component has corresponding CSS Module (e.g., `experience/experience.js` + `experience/styles.module.css`)
- **Component Architecture**: Vertical Timeline wraps individual timeline elements; each element receives a single data object

### Styling
- **Global**: Only `/src/css/custom.css` for Infima CSS variable overrides (colors only)
- **Dark Mode**: CSS vars automatically switch via `[data-theme='dark']` selector
- Color scheme: `--ifm-color-primary: #2e8555` (light), `#25c2a0` (dark)
- **Component Styles**: Always use CSS Modules (`.module.css`): `import styles from './styles.module.css'` → `className={styles.className}`
- **KaTeX**: Equations render via `$...$` (inline) or `$$...$$` (blocks); styling imported in custom.css

### Build & Development
```bash
npm start                    # Start dev server (localhost:3000)
npm run build                # Production build to /build directory
npm run serve                # Serve built site locally
npm run clear                # Clear build cache
npm run write-heading-ids    # Generate heading anchors for docs
```

## Critical Developer Workflows

### Adding LeetCode Solutions
1. Create `.md` in `/docs/leetcode/` with naming: `leetcode_[number].md`
2. Structure: `# Leetcode-N. Title` → `## 題目說明` → `## 解題思路` → `## 參考解法1` (with code blocks)
3. Code block format: `` ```cpp title="C++ Solution N: (Description)" showLineNumbers ``
4. Always run `npm run write-heading-ids` post-creation to generate anchor links
5. Sidebar auto-generates from folder structure; no config needed unless using `_category_.json`

### Adding Blog Posts
1. Create `.md` or `.mdx` in `/blog/` with ISO prefix: `YYYY-MM-DD-title.md`
2. Include YAML frontmatter: `slug`, `title`, `authors`, `tags`
3. MDX enables embedded React: `import Component from './path'` + `<Component />`
4. Reading time auto-calculates (enabled in docusaurus.config.js)

### Updating Experience/Projects Components
1. Edit JSON data: `/src/helper/experience.json` or `/src/helper/Projects.json`
2. Experience object shape: `{ title, name, icon, iconBg, date, points[] }`
3. Projects object shape: `{ projectTitle, projectDescribe, tech[] }`
4. Components auto-rerender on restart; no code changes needed

### Homepage Customization
- Edit `/src/pages/index.js` (hot reload works)
- Imports components from `/src/components/` and data from `/src/helper/`
- Wraps content in Docusaurus `<Layout>` for consistent theming

## Critical Constraints & Gotchas

- **Node 18+**: Required & enforced in package.json; older versions fail during build
- **Broken Links**: `onBrokenLinks: 'throw'` causes build to fail on broken internal links (e.g., `/docs/nonexistent`)
- **Language**: Single locale `zh-Hant` (Traditional Chinese); i18n not active
- **Sidebar Autogen**: `sidebars.js` uses `{ type: 'autogenerated' }` — sidebar auto-generates from `/docs` folder structure; manual edits will be overwritten
- **Markdown Links**: `onBrokenMarkdownLinks: 'warn'` = only warns; doesn't fail build (fix manually)

## Common Workflows for AI Agents

**When adding new docs:**
- File naming: `leetcode_[number].md` in `/docs/leetcode/`
- Always run `npm run write-heading-ids` post-creation
- Verify sidebar with `npm start` (autogenerated sidebar may take moment to update)

**When updating components:**
- Edit JSON in `/src/helper/*.json` → restart dev server (hot reload works)
- React component changes: edit `.js` in `/src/components/` (hot reload applies automatically)
- CSS changes: edit `.module.css` files alongside components

**When styling:**
- Global CSS: only edit `/src/css/custom.css` (Infima vars & colors only)
- Component CSS: always use `.module.css` files with `import styles from './styles.module.css'`
- Dark mode: CSS vars automatically switch via `[data-theme='dark']`

**When debugging build failures:**
- **Most common**: Broken internal links → run `npm run build` to see which file/link is broken
- Run `npm run clear` before rebuild if stale cache suspected
- Verify file naming conventions: `leetcode_N.md`, `YYYY-MM-DD-title.md`
- Check for circular imports or missing exports in `/src` components

## Integration Points

- **Deployment**: Vercel (configured in docusaurus.config.js)
- **Analytics**: Vercel Analytics (`<Analytics />` component in homepage)
- **Code Highlighting**: Prism React Renderer with custom line highlighting
- **External**: Framer Motion (animations), React Lazy Load Image, React Tilt (3D effects)
